intervals.quote: BESI operated from 1989 until 1995, when it was upgraded to BESII, and BEPC was also upgraded.

summary.plain: The first Beijing Spectrometer: a drift-chamber and streamer-tube calorimeter detector around the collision point of BEPC, designed to measure charged particles and photons in the tau-charm energy region.
summary.technical: BESI: central drift chamber inside a main drift chamber, electromagnetic calorimeter of self-quenching streamer tubes interleaved with lead.

technology.quote: BESI had a central drift chamber (CDC) surrounded by the main drift chamber (MDC). Its electromagnetic calorimeter was composed of self quenching streamer tubes interleaved with lead.
technology.value: Central drift chamber (CDC) inside a main drift chamber (MDC) with an electromagnetic calorimeter of self-quenching streamer tubes interleaved with lead
